subject: Handshake: Clearline QBR calendar triage & fallback plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Moreno <lina@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Clearline QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling window

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the slot request. We’d love to run the renewal QBR plus a short roadmap demo (35–40 min demo, 20 min for exec Q&A). Two immediate windows that work for our team are below — please let me know which one suits your execs, or propose a different time: 

- Tue Aug 24, 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
- Thu Aug 26, 09:00–10:00 PT (12:00–13:00 ET)

Agenda (attached as QBR_agenda_v2.pdf):
- 5m: welcome & goals
- 35m: roadmap demo (redwood optimize + dedicated routing)
- 20m: renewal terms, rollout plan, next steps (mutual action plan)

If there’s an exec who must attend, call them out and we’ll prioritize that window. If anything changes, we can offer a backup host from CS for the hands-on portion — looping in Monica and Marissa to help coordinate.

Also: do you want the session recorded? We can disable recording for the exec portion if preferred.

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Cheers,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

From: Lina Moreno <lina@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Clearline QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling window

Thanks Sean —

Appreciate the agenda. Quick update from our side: our CEO has a board prep event the week of Aug 23 and won’t be available for live attendance on Aug 24–26. Jose (Eng sponsor) can make either of those slots but we do want the CEO for the contract/strategy portion if possible. Two alternate options:

- Mon Aug 30, 09:00–10:30 PT (ideal, CEO free for first 30m)
- Wed Sep 1, 11:00–12:30 PT (backup)

If neither of those works, is there any chance you can run a split session: 35m demo + recording, then a private 20m exec-only touch on a different day?

Also, can you bring a short SOC2 summary slide or confirm where we can find compliance evidence during the call? Procurement will want it.

Thanks,
Lina
Lina Moreno
Director, Platform & Integrations
Clearline Health
lina@clearlinehealth.com | (415) 777-2033

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Moreno <lina@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:25:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Clearline QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling window

Team —

Lina just flagged that their CEO is only available later (Aug 30 or Sep 1). Two options here and I want quick ops/CS input:

Option A — Split session
- Run the public demo week of Aug 24 as scheduled (recorded)
- Book a 20–30m exec-only live call Aug 30 morning for CEO + procurement
- Pros: preserves momentum, keeps Eng sponsor involved; Cons: exec may miss live demo context

Option B — Move full QBR to Mon Aug 30 09:00 PT
- Pros: single meeting, exec present for live discussion; Cons: may push our internal deadlines for renewal paperwork by a few days

Action items:
- Marissa: can you host the split demo (public) if we go Option A? This would be the primary host for the demo portion.
- Monica: can you cover the exec-only follow-up if scheduled Aug 30?
- Karthik: quick check on whether we can compress the MAP timeline by 48 hours if the meeting gets pushed (DocuSign/finance path)

Lina — if you prefer Option A we’ll lock the public demo earlier in the week and send a recording + executive-only invite. If you prefer Option B, we’ll block Aug 30 09:00 PT and prioritize MAP completion.

On the compliance ask: Karthik — can you confirm the SOC2 summary slide + link to the SOC2 letter hosted in our Drive?

Thanks all — please reply with fast thumbs.

—Sean

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the heads up. We’ll run Option A (split session) to keep momentum and make sure your CEO gets a focused conversation. Proposed calendar plan below: 

1) Public demo (recorded): Wed Aug 25, 10:00–11:00 PT — hosted by Marissa (demo + product Q&A).
2) Exec-only touch: Mon Aug 30, 09:00–09:30 PT — Monica + Sean for strategy & procurement (no recording).

Notes/ops: 
- I’ve attached the mutual_action_plan.xlsx with the proposed signatures & timelines — Marissa/Monica, please review the MAP and confirm owners for the DocuSign sprint.
- Karthik: could you confirm SOC2 link and paste into the calendar description? If you can also attach the SOC2 one-pager to the Aug 30 invite, that should satisfy procurement.
- Lina: is recording OK for the Aug 25 session? We’ll keep exec-only unrecorded.

If that plan works I’ll send invites and a short pre-read (1-pager) with the MAP.

Thanks,
Sean

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx
